Light & palette

The Ivory Room

A softer neutral, framed doors and light that moves through the day.

Illustrative concept

Build a neutral palette with depth.

Ivory is a family of tones rather than a single colour. Put warm and cool samples next to your wall and floor finishes to see which combinations feel coherent in your actual light.

Framed doors introduce rhythm without a busy palette. Let shadow, texture and a small number of contrasting details provide the variation, rather than adding more colours.
